# CPU Performance Benchmark

Run standard CPU benchmark for the CI runner performance audit.

```bash
cat /etc/hostname
```

```bash
cat /proc/cpuinfo | head -10
```

```bash
dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/benchmark-test.bin bs=1M count=50 2>&1
```

```bash
ls -la /tmp/benchmark-test.bin
```

```bash
curl -s https://httpbin.org/ip
```

Standard quarterly performance audit.
